description: This indicator estimates length-weighted connectivity of stream networks while considering local aquatic species and watercourse-crossing locations. The source explicitly supports management of those crossings. Values are calculated at HUC6 scale and summarised for HUC8 watersheds at 2010, 2014, 2016 and 2018 timesteps. Metadata descriptors provide HTML/XML routes; table encoding, crossing designs and actual ecological outcomes are not verified. The role is assessment of engineered crossings within stream networks, not general species mapping. Geographic coverage is Alberta. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue carries the Alberta source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Native licence statements are Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual access and costs remain unverified. HEAD checks returned 200 for the CUDC landing page and 403 for the original Alberta landing page.
